name: hcapp_deleteTrackImport
description: Clears one of the caller's own track-import uploads off their Import Tracks list (E5.F5.S8) by stamping HC.TrackImport.DeletedAt. The row and its BlobUrl are kept (the archives are retained on purpose for historic-run discovery) and tracks already imported from the upload are untouched — they belong to the runs now. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 101, standard token). Authorization: the row must have HasherId = the token's user and DeletedAt NULL → else 1011 'not found' (errorType 3, revealing nothing about other people's uploads); a job with Status = 1 (processing — the slice loop and the nightly backstop still read it) is refused with 1012 (errorType 2). Both checks are pre-flight, before the transaction.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The upload to clear. Must belong to the caller and must not be mid-import.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Envelope only. { success } on success; { success, errorCode, errorType } on failure.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: 1011 not found / not the caller's / already cleared; 1012 still processing; 1013 unhandled; ValidateAppAuth 1201 (invalid token) / 1301 (device) / 1201 (signed out).

columns.name: jobId
columns.description: Echo of the cleared upload's id.

rowsets.description: Returned in place of DeletedJob on any failure.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.TrackImport SET DeletedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = @jobId AND HasherId = @userId AND DeletedAt IS NULL — inside a transaction. The blob is NOT deleted and imported tracks are NOT removed.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1011, 1012 (pre-flight) and in the CATCH (1013, after ROLLBACK).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @jobId (lines 2-4) have no SQL default. A client that omits any of them is refused by SQL BEFORE the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and the SP's own graceful checks are unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29). A NULL @jobId VALUE is handled (no row → 1011); omission is not.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
